from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
program = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = Counter()
    for row in grid:
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            candidates[row[0]] += 1
    for c in range(w):
        col = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(col)) == 1:
            candidates[col[0]] += 1
    divider = candidates.most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == divider for v in row)]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    def regions(length, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [length]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1) if bounds[i+1] > bounds[i]+1]
    rows = regions(h, row_seps)
    cols = regions(w, col_seps)
    values = Counter(grid[r][c] for r0,r1 in rows for c0,c1 in cols
                     for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if grid[r][c] != divider)
    background = values.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) >= 2 else 5
             for c0,c1 in cols] for r0,r1 in rows]
'''
programs = base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
